releaseNotes:
🚀 3.5 Update!

- NEW: Português (Brasil/Portugal). The app follows your phone's language automatically
- Enable Fixed Performance now has an Aggressive mode: it also turns off battery saver, adaptive battery and Doze for maximum performance. Expect more heat and faster battery drain. RESET undoes it
- Custom DPI input: turn off "Auto calculate DPI" to type your own DPI in Change Screen Resolution (Direct Change and Floating Menu)
- Real-time Hardware Monitor now has 2 new rows: STO (storage used/total) and NET (live download/upload speed)
